Question 7
?

Consider the arc of the curve y=x2−3x that lies in the fourth quadrant between its x-intercepts. What integral gives the area of the surface generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
2π∫02x2x2−4x+5dx
b
2π∫03x2x2−4x+5dx
c
2π∫03x4x2−12x+10dx
d
2π∫03(x2−3x)4x2−12x+10dx
e
2π∫02(x2−3x)4x2+5dx
Submit
